hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac
out=$(pnpm check 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo 'pnpm check failed (typecheck + lint) - fix these before committing' >&2; exit 2; fi
out=$(pnpm check 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo 'pnpm check failed (typecheck + lint) - fix these before opening a PR' >&2; exit 2; fi
